Kelly: Baby Luca is here!! 7:02am, 7lbs 3oz, everyone healthy. Mom and baby are both snoozing :heart: :tada:
Tony: Woooo congrats Kelly!!! let me know if you want me to grab anything from the office, beer? snacks? :partyparrot:
Priya: OMG congrats!! sending all the cuddles. do you have a photo?? :smiling_face_with_3_hearts:
Kelly: Thanks y'all. Quick pic attached in thread (sending after naps). I'm going to take my paternity leave starting tomorrow — Jamie can you run the morning sync for next two weeks?
Jamie: Yep, I got the morning sync. I can also handle the weekly deploy signoff while you're out. Enjoy the naps! :coffee:
Ben: Congrats! I signed up to cover the on-call rotation nights 3/5 — message me if you need any extra swaps.
Rachel: Meal train link: https://www.mealtrain.com/trains/abcd1234 — I added a note for dietary prefs. Happy to coordinate drop-offs.
Priya: If you want, I can knit tiny hats. free service :). Also there is a newborn gear list in #people-ops if you need recommendations.
Kelly: Appreciate it. Will DM about a couple of items. Also please hold off on posting pics publicly — family wants a couple days for private sharing.
Tony: totally understood. obvious question: when can we expect the tiny office cameo? :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Kelly: Haha probably in late spring — we live a bit out of town. But I will send a baby-plant to the office to represent him :seedling:
DevBot: Reminder: Kelly's OOO set for 2026-03-24 to 2026-04-07 (auto-created from calendar).
Ben: Adding a congrats gif in the thread :tada: (reacted :tada:)
Rachel: Sending meal volunteers to you, Kelly. So excited!! :heart:
